title: Pure totals
goal: Totals are computed one way, tested
acceptance: A pure function over legs and stops: per leg, per day, a set of days and the whole trip
A→B + B stay + B→C…; from and to have no stay; tests on invented trips
privacy: Neutral, invented test data only; no owner places, home address, photos, routes or API keys in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Planned 2026-11-25 in the upfront step plan: scoped to one PR, at most 0.5 focused day(s). Not a measurement.
